# Setup

```{r Setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
rm(list=ls())
```


This script creates a dendrogram of the bio-optical phenotype data from the Fiji 2025 expedition.

### Load Packages
```{r, echo=F}
##Install Packages if Needed
if (!require("ggplot2")) install.packages("ggplot2")
if (!require("dplyr")) install.packages("dplyr")

##Load Packages
library(ggplot2) #Required for ggplots
library(dplyr)
library(gplots)
library(gridExtra)
library(car)
library(vegan)
library(reshape)
library(reshape2)
library(broom)
library(pvclust)
library(dendextend)
library(colorspace)
library(circlize)
library(viridis)
library(caret)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(igraph)
library(fs)
library(here)
```

# Making dendrogram 

```{r dendro}
sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("Outputs", "AS26_MAPPmetadata.csv"))


#load(file = here("Data", "cbb_AS26_expt_1000bs_updated.RData")) #loads cbb
load(file = here("Data", "cbb_AS26_expt_1000bs_updatedw9icra3.RData"))

##### label color coding ####### 
#load(file = here("Data", "cbb_AS26_expt_1000bs_updated.RData")) #loads cbb

# Create a named color vector (each unique species, i.e. SiteID gets a color)
#site_ids <- unique(guam_mapplist$mapp_no)
site_ids <- unique(sample_metadata$Species)

#site_colors <- setNames(magma(length(site_ids)), site_ids)
#my_custom_palette <- c( "chartreuse3", "violetred3", "sienna2", "orchid") 
#my_custom_palette <- c( "#482173", "#2e6f8e", "#29af74", "#bddf26")
my_custom_palette <- c("#FFCB05",  "#00B2A9", "#00274C", "#702082")

site_colors <- setNames(my_custom_palette[1:length(site_ids)], site_ids)

# Get the label order from the dendrogram
dend_labels <- labels(as.dendrogram(cbb))
#dend_labels <- labels(as.dendrogram(cbb))
# Match SiteIDs to dendrogram label order
#label_sites <- trimws(sample_metadata$Species[match(dend_labels, sample_metadata$SampleID)])
# Get the color for each label based on its SiteID
#label_colors <- site_colors[label_sites]
#cb <- color_labels(as.dendrogram(cbb), col = label_colors)


# Convert to dendrogram
d_obj <- as.dendrogram(cbb)
# 3. Use the cleaned labels to match your SiteIDs
dend_labels <- labels(d_obj)
#dend_labels_clean <- sub("_002$", "", dend_labels)
#dend_labels_clean <- sub("\\._(02|05)r$", "", dend_labels_clean)
dend_labels_clean <- dend_labels %>%
    tolower() %>%
  sub("\\.processed\\.csv$", "", .) %>%
  sub("\\._?\\d{2,3}r$", "", .) %>%   # handles ._02r OR .002r
  trimws()

colnames(sample_metadata) <- make.names(colnames(sample_metadata), unique = TRUE)

#sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
  #filter(`CBASS / Sophie` == "CBASS") %>%
 # filter(!is.na(`CBASS / Sophie`)) %>%
#  filter(!is.na(UniqueID)) %>%
#  filter(!grepl("^[aoiAOI]", UniqueID))

sample_metadata$UniqueID <- sample_metadata$UniqueID %>%
  tolower() %>%
  trimws()

label_sites <- sample_metadata$Species[
  match(dend_labels_clean, sample_metadata$UniqueID)
]
 label_colors <- site_colors[label_sites]
 label_colors[is.na(label_colors)] <- "black"
d_obj <- dendextend::set(d_obj, what = "labels_col", value = label_colors)

#only analyze data here from experiment
#label_sites <- trimws(sample_metadata$Species[match(dend_labels_clean, sample_metadata$UniqueID)])


# Overwrite the actual label text for ease of viewing/reading
labels(d_obj) <- labels(d_obj) %>%
  tolower() %>%
  sub("\\.processed\\.csv$", "", .) %>%   # remove file suffix
  sub("\\.\\d{3}r$", "", .) %>%           # remove .002r / .005r
  trimws()

#make sure there are no duplicates
table(labels(d_obj)) %>% sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>% head()
```


```{r dendro}
#labels_cex(cb)<-0.8
labels_cex(d_obj) <- 0.8
#define path
samp_circle <- here("Plots", "Dendro-Species_expt_circle.pdf")
pdf(file = samp_circle, width = 12, height = 12, bg = "transparent")
circlize_dendrogram(d_obj,labels_track_height = 0.05,dend_track_height = 0.45)
legend("topright", legend = names(site_colors), fill = site_colors, title = "Species")
dev.off()

#horizonatl
labels_cex(d_obj) <- 0.3
samp_tree <- here("Plots", "Dendro-Species_expt_tree.pdf")
pdf(file = samp_tree, width = 10, height = 12)
plot(d_obj, horiz = TRUE,
     main = "Dendrogram - Species",
     ylab = "Height")

legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = names(site_colors),
  fill = site_colors,
  title = "Species",
  cex = 0.8
)
dev.off()
```
